pageDescription: The photo albums of this site.
listEmpty: No album yet. Come back soon!
albumEmpty: This album has no photo yet.
externalOut: This link opens {host} in a new tab: you leave this site.
previewBanner: Preview: this album is not published yet. Only people who have this link can see it.
imageError: This photo does not load. Try again in a moment.
consentDefault: The people shown in these photos agreed to their publication. Do you recognise yourself in a photo and prefer it to disappear?
removalLink: Ask for a photo to be removed
removalTitle: Ask for a photo to be removed
removalIntro: Tell us which photo concerns you: we take it down, no questions asked, if you appear in it.
removalWhichHint: Give the album name and the photo number, or paste the address of the photo's page. Example: Summer party, photo 12.
removalMessageHint: Explain in a few words. Example: “I am the person on the left in this photo and I would rather it was not published.”
removalContactHint: Only if you want an answer. It is erased as soon as your request is handled.
removalSent: Thank you, your request is sent. We will look at it soon.
removalLimit: You already sent several requests. Try again in an hour.
removalInvalid: A message is missing (a few words are enough), or the photo concerned.
removalFull: Too many requests are already waiting for an answer. Try again later.
removalError: Sending did not work. Try again in a moment.
removalThanksText: Your request arrived. The team reads it quickly: if you appear in the photo, it is hidden.
removalFailText: Your request could not be sent (too many requests, missing message or a failure). Go back to the form and try again in a moment.
trapLabel: Do not fill in this field
mailSubject: A photo takedown request is waiting for you
mailBody: A visitor asks for a photo to be taken down. They wrote:
mailAdmin: To handle it (hide the photo in one click):
mailThrottle: You will get at most one e-mail like this every 6 hours.
studioIntro: Choose your photos: they are shrunk on your device (about {kb} KB each) before being sent, and the hidden information in the files (GPS position, camera, date) is removed.
studioNoScript: This page needs JavaScript to shrink photos before sending. Turn it on in your browser.
studioLogin: You are not signed in to the administration. Sign in, then come back to this page.
studioNoAlbum: This album no longer exists or does not take uploaded photos.
studioErrDenied: Your role does not allow adding photos.
studioWaiting: Album “{title}”: {count} photo(s) out of {max} at most.
studioPickHelp: You can choose several at once. Formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP (iPhone HEIC photos too, if your browser can open them).
studioAlt: Description for people who cannot see the image (recommended)
studioAltHelp: Describe what the photo shows, as you would to someone on the phone. Example: “Two people set up lights on a stage.”
studioErrType: This file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
studioGif: Animated images (GIF) are not accepted here. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
studioHeic: Your browser cannot open this HEIC photo. Export it as JPEG from your phone, then try again.
studioErrDecode: This photo is damaged or unreadable. Try another one.
studioErrSize: This photo stays too heavy even when shrunk (limit: {kb} KB). Try a smaller version.
studioErrFull: The album is full ({max} photos). For a bigger album, give the link of an album on another service.
studioErrSpace: There is not enough room left for photos on the site.
studioErrNetwork: The connection dropped while sending. Check it, then try again.
studioErrOther: Sending did not work. Try again in a moment.
studioTooMany: There is no room left in this album ({max} photos at most).
studioSummary: {done} photo(s) sent out of {total}. To fix: {errors}.
studioAllDone: Done: all the photos are added. They stay hidden while the album is not published.
studioCapacity: You can still add {room} photo(s) after these.
studioOpenAlbum: Back to the album in the administration
starterHelp: Pick a starting point: it suggests fitting words and settings (page title, album order, dates) and prepares a sample album as a draft, invisible to visitors. You can change everything afterwards, and this choice never deletes anything.
tpl_retro_about: Event albums, newest first, with their date.
tpl_portfolio_about: Your work in the order you choose, without dates.
tpl_empty_about: Nothing prepared: you start from a blank page.
seedDesc: This is a sample album, as a draft. Edit it, add photos and publish it, or delete it.
seedExternal: Example: a big album on another service
seedExternalDesc: For an album too big for your site, a card leads to an album on another service. Replace the address with yours.
noPageBanner: This gallery has no address on the site: give it a path in the “General” tab so visitors can see it.
bannerRequests: {count} photo takedown request(s) waiting for an answer.
usageLine: Space used: {used} MB of {max} MB · {albums} album(s) of {maxAlbums} · {photos} photo(s).
albumsNone: No album yet. Click “Create an album”.
sortHint: Albums are shown newest first according to their date. To choose the order yourself, set “Album order” in the “Settings” tab.
actDeleteAlbum: Delete this album and its photos
confirmDeletePhoto: Delete this photo for good? The file is erased.
confirmDeleteAlbum: Delete this album and ALL its photos for good?
confirmUnpublish: Take this album off the site? Visitors will no longer see it (you keep it as a draft).
pubLabelOff: This album is a draft: only you and people you give the preview link to can see it.
linkSee: See the page on the site
copyLabel: Address of the page to share
linkSeeAlbum: See the album on the site
fDateHelp: The date of the event or project. Optional.
fDescHelp: A few sentences. A blank line separates two paragraphs. Optional.
fModeHelp: On this site: you upload the photos here (limited number). On another service: the album is a card leading to an album you have elsewhere.
fLink: Address of the album on the other service
fLinkHelp: Required if the album is on another service. Optional otherwise: a “See all the photos” link is then added under the thumbnails. Example: https://photos.example.org/my-album
fStateHelp: A draft is only visible to you. Publishing needs the right to publish.
errTitle: Write a title. Example: Spring party 2025.
errLinkBad: Write a full address starting with https://, for example https://photos.example.org/my-album.
errLinkNeeded: For an album on another service, paste its full address, for example https://photos.example.org/my-album.
errDate: Write the date as year-month-day. Example: 2025-03-14.
errNoPublishRight: You do not have the right to publish or take down an album. Leave “Draft”.
errNotFound: Not found: it may already have been deleted.
errGeneric: That could not be done. Try again.
errFullAlbums: You reached the maximum number of albums ({max}). Delete one or raise the limit in the advanced settings.
errFullPhotos: This album is full ({max} photos). For a bigger album, put the link of an album on another service.
errFullSpace: There is not enough room left for new photos ({mb} MB in total). Delete photos or raise the limit in the advanced settings.
errBadUrl: Write a full address starting with https://, for example https://images.example.org/photo.jpg.
errNoHosts: No site is allowed for photos by address. Add one in the advanced settings (“Allowed sites”).
errHostNotAllowed: This site is not in the list of allowed sites ({hosts}). Add it in the advanced settings.
errCoverHidden: A hidden photo cannot be the cover. Show it first.
errImageType: This file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errImageCorrupt: This photo is damaged or unreadable.
errImageSize: This photo is too heavy (limit: {kb} KB).
errImageDimensions: This photo is too large in pixels. Shrink it first.
okHidden: Photo hidden: it no longer appears on the site.
okClosedNoPhoto: Request marked as handled. It did not point to a precise photo: hide it yourself in the album.
orderHelp: Click “Up” or “Down” (or “To the top”). Nothing to drag.
altMissing: {count} photo(s) without a description for people who cannot see the image. Open the photo (“Edit”) to add it: it matters for accessibility.
albumRoom: {count} photo(s) out of {max} at most in this album · {left} MB of room left on the site.
photosNone: No photo. Click “Add photos”: you can choose several at once.
externalAlbumHelp: This album is a card leading to another service: visitors see a clear sentence saying they leave this site. You can upload a cover photo (“Add photos”).
externalAlbumNoLink: The address of the album on the other service is missing. Click “Edit the album” to paste it.
externalCoverHelp: The first visible photo is used as the card's cover.
fCaptionHelp: Short sentence shown under the photo. Example: “Volunteers at the opening”.
fAlt: Description for people who cannot see the image
fAltHelp: Think of accessibility: describe what the photo shows, as you would to someone on the phone. Example: “Two people set up lights on a stage.” Without a description, an automatic text is read instead.
fHiddenHelp: A hidden photo disappears from the site right away, without being erased: you can show it again.
fPhotoUrlHelp: A full address starting with https:// on an allowed site ({hosts}). The photo stays on that site.
reqNone: No request. When a visitor asks for a photo to be taken down, it will arrive here.
reqHelp: A visitor asked for a photo to be taken down. Read their message, then hide the photo (it disappears from the site right away) or dismiss the request. Handled requests erase themselves after {days} days.
reqMaskConfirm: Hide this photo from the site and mark the request as handled?
reqMaskHelp: “Hide the photo” deletes nothing: you can show it again later from the album. The person's e-mail is erased as soon as the request is handled.
reqDismissConfirm: Dismiss this request without hiding a photo?
